statement: For any fixed finite set R of genuine critical-line zeta zeros, using all multiplicity jets, there is an explicitly computable C_R with (logN)Delta_N² >= sum_R m_rho²/|rho|²-C_R/logN for logN>=1. More generally every exact cutoff-phase trial vector yields Delta_N²>=2Re(a*b)-a*Ga without an invertibility assumption.
hypotheses: True certified zero labels, derivative indices below actual multiplicity, fixed set and certified separations/phase derivatives. No RH, no uniform growth of C_R. Ordinary complex coefficients, full Cauchy norm.

statement: Under RH, for each fixed 0<b<1, constrain input coefficients a_n=mu(n)(1-logn/logN) for n<=N^b and leave the suffix arbitrary complex. Both unrestricted ||1-zeta A||_* and anchored ||1-zeta(A-A(1))||_* optimized squared costs times logN tend to C(b)=sum_distinctrho c_mrho(b)/|rho|², with c_m=m²b+v*M^-1v and M_ij=(1-b^(i+j+1))/(i+j+1),v_j=-delta_j0+m b^(j+1)/(j+1).
hypotheses: RH; fixed b before N limit; prefix imposed on input A, not on actual anchored polynomial after subtraction; source main adaptive proof and its recorded fixed-Laurent qualification. No moving-b uniformity or Theorem6 adoption.

statement: The gamma-tail compact Mellin tests with k=ceil(logN), A=N,R=ceil(4NlogN) transfer every fixed critical-line zero jet to arbitrary bounded-residual integer polynomials. Their normalized Gram tends to the confluent Hilbert blocks, with no separate suffix-coefficient bound.

statement: The exact unitary map (Ba)_n=sum_(j<n)a_j-n a_n sends disk Hardy space onto weighted unit-step S. Source T_tau becomes jump phase J_tau, M J_tau f(s)=(s-i tau)Mf(s-i tau)/s and ||J_tau||=sqrt(1+tau²)+|tau|.
hypotheses: S subset L²([1,infinity),dx/x²), all real tau; critical Mellin Hardy measure dt/(2pi). Sharp norm uses ambient norm and integer dilation/step approximation.

statement: For fixed nonprincipal chi, W_chi closed span of g_k=S_chi(x/k)-S_chi(x)/k in unit-step S, dist(J_tau g_k,W_chi)>=|L(1-i tau,chi)| |k^(i tau)-1|/k unconditionally. Under unanchored density W_chi=ker M(.,1) and equality holds. For every fixed k>=2,tau nonzero with k^(i tau)=1, membership J_tau g_k in W_chi is equivalent to fixed-chi GRH. No nonzero tau leaves all W_chi invariant.

Forward density from separately reconstructed fixed-character GRH theorem. Complex-chi functional symmetry and imprimitive Euler Re0 zeros retained.

statement: For nonzero tau, the jump-transported zeta generator rho_k has infinitely many formal nonzero prime floor coefficients -(p^(i tau)-1)/k, so belongs to no finite ordinary length span. A separate l² model has perfect unconstrained approximation and norm1 transport but constrained prefix limit b/(1-b), precluding a generic subreciprocal-rate inference from density or membership.
hypotheses: k>=2 fixed, tau nonzero. The abstract prefix countermodel is not the arithmetic Mobius sequence.

statement: For fixed 0<d<=1/16, I=[7/8+d,1-d], Delta_d=min_(eta in[d,1/8-d])(2eta-eta/(1-4eta))>0, the multiplicity weighted sum H_I=sum_(0<gamma<=T,beta in I)T^(2beta-1)/(1+log²T(beta-.5)²) is O_(d,epsilon)(T^(1-Delta_d+epsilon)/log²T).
